description: This file defines an abstract class ScopedTransactionsTestRunner for testing transactional behavior in Orleans grains, including methods for creating transactions, handling failures, and nested transactions.

classes.name: ScopedTransactionsTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to run and verify transactional grain operations within tests.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValue
methods.description: Creates a transaction scope, sets a grain value, and asserts no failure occurs.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValueWithFailure
methods.description: Creates a transaction scope, attempts to set a grain value with an expected failure, and asserts the failure.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValueAndAssert
methods.description: Creates a transaction scope, sets a grain value, retrieves it, and asserts the value.

methods.name: CreateNestedTransactionScopeAndSetValueAndInnerFailAndAssert
methods.description: Creates nested transaction scopes, induces a failure in inner transaction, and asserts the outer grain value remains consistent.
